about_the_game:
Monkey Jump is a colorful and chaotic party game where you play as a fun-loving monkey! Whether you're going solo or jumping in with up to 8 players, the goal is simple — have as much fun (and laughter) as possible!

In this playful world, take control of your monkey character and jump, dash, race, and more across hilarious and unpredictable challenges. With dynamic gameplay and quirky animations, every session brings something new — and usually something ridiculous!

Customization is also a big part of the experience. Want to stand out in the crowd? Pick your favorite color, throw on a stylish hat, and edit your player profile to create a monkey that truly represents you.

Key Features:

🧍 1–8 Player Support: Play solo or team up with friends for some wild multiplayer madness — both online and local modes supported!

🎮 Fun & Unique Gameplay Mechanics: From unpredictable physics to chaotic obstacle courses, every round is a fresh dose of excitement.

🎨 Character Color Customization: Choose your favorite color and make your monkey truly your own.

🎩 Hat Selection: Add personality to your monkey with a variety of fun and funky hats!

🧾 Detailed Profile Customization: Change your name, icon, and more to personalize your experience.

Monkey Jump is the perfect game for players of all ages looking for fast-paced fun, creative customization, and laugh-out-loud moments. With its colorful design and lively energy, it's the ultimate party game to enjoy solo or with friends!
